title: subagent: Find Outer Wilds Wikipedia revisions

content:
I need to find out how many revisions the Wikipedia page for "Outer Wilds" had before May 2019 (its release month). 

Please try to use the tools available to you:

1. Try websearch: search "Outer Wilds Wikipedia page history revisions"
2. Try webfetch to visit https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Outer_Wilds&action=history to see the revision history
3. Try webfetch to visit https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&titles=Outer_Wilds&prop=revisions&rvprop=timestamp&rvlimit=5000&format=json to get all revisions
4. Try webfetch to visit https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outer_Wilds to confirm the release date

The key question is: Outer Wilds was released on May 21, 2019. I need to count how many revisions the Wikipedia page had before May 2019 (i.e., before the release date month).

Alternatively, try webfetching the Wikipedia revision count API or the page history to find this information.

Report back the total number of revisions before May 2019.
I'll start by gathering information from multiple sources in parallel.

arguments.prompt: List all revision timestamps and count them. I need to know how many revisions existed before May 2019 (before 2019-05-01).
What is the release date of Outer Wilds? Confirm it was released in May 2019.
